name: Niceboard
endpoint_template: https://{board_domain}/sitemap-jobs.xml (list of /job/{id}-{slug} URLs) -> each job page has JSON-LD JobPosting
pagination: None needed: sitemap-jobs.xml lists all active jobs (index sitemap.xml -> sitemap-base/jobs/companies). /api/jobs exists but returns {success:false,error:validation} without required params (undocumented; robots allows /api/jobs).
platform_signature: Asset URLs niceboard.co/boards/{boardslug}/assets/... in HTML; /sitemap.xml index with sitemap-base/jobs/companies; job URLs /job/{numeric-id}-{slug}; robots.txt 'Disallow: /api/ Allow: /api/jobs' + Crawl-delay: 1
limitations: Crawl-delay 1s in robots.txt; no official public API docs; /api/ disallowed except /api/jobs. No auth/captcha seen. JSON-LD verified on aiacolorado job page.
notes: Sitemap+JSON-LD is generic but board is identifiable by niceboard.co asset URLs. Only 2 boards confirmed (third not found in budget).

name: WP Job Manager
endpoint_template: https://{site}{/subpath}/?feed=job_feed  (RSS with job_listing:* namespace)  |  alt: https://{site}{/subpath}/wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings?per_page=100&page=N (JSON, when REST enabled)
config_params: site base URL (may include subpath e.g. /acrejobs)
pagination: Feed: &posts_per_page=N&paged=N (default 10 items; jobicy returned 200). REST: per_page<=100, page, headers X-WP-Total/X-WP-TotalPages. Feed only includes jobs with a job type.
platform_signature: RSS feed with job_listing:* XML namespace; REST route /wp/v2/job-listings; HTML classes job_listing / job_listing_category-*; plugin path /wp-content/plugins/wp-job-manager/
limitations: REST route can be disabled/protected per site; jobicy REST returned Cloudflare challenge 403 (not bypassed) but RSS worked; some sites (onwardsearch.com/jobs) are not WPJM anymore. Feed excludes jobs without type. No auth for public feed.
notes: Highly deployed (100k+ sites). Self-hosted WordPress so board identity = site URL, not a SaaS tenant. Prefer RSS feed (uniform), REST for full pagination.

name: SmartJobBoard
endpoint_template: https://{board_domain}/rss  (also /feeds/rss.xml); sitemap https://{board_domain}/sitemap.xml; job pages /job/{id}/{slug}/ contain JSON-LD JobPosting
pagination: RSS returns latest 29-50 items only (acem 29, others 50); for full coverage use sitemap.xml + JSON-LD per job page.
fields_available: JSON-LD: full description, datePosted, validThrough, employmentType, hiringOrganization, jobLocation, baseSalary
platform_signature: <generator>Smart Job Board</generator> in RSS; HTML contains SJB_GlobalSiteUrl / SJB_UserSiteUrl JS vars and assets smartjobboard.com/{version}/templates/{BreezeDND|BootstrapDND|FlowDND}/
limitations: Some boards sit behind Cloudflare managed challenge (jobs.psychologicalscience.org, academiccareers.com home, jobs.buckrail.com /rss returned 403) - not bypassed; treat as BLOCKED per-instance. robots.txt on tested boards only disallows /files/, /download/, /application-redirect/. SmartJobBoard has a paid private API (not public).
notes: RSS is capped (~50) so combine with sitemap + JSON-LD. Strong signature.

name: JobBoard.io
endpoint_template: https://{board_domain}/jobs.rss (also /rss, /feed); sitemap https://{board_domain}/sitemap.xml; job pages /jobs/{numeric-id}-{slug} contain JSON-LD JobPosting
pagination: RSS returns latest ~7-34 items only (no paging param observed); full list via sitemap.xml + JSON-LD per job page.
platform_signature: Rails app: <meta name=csrf-param authenticity_token>, /assets/application-*.js, uploads/job/logo/{id}/..., RSS at /jobs.rss with <atom:link> and generator = board name, robots.txt disallowing /jobs/*/tracker, /jobs/*/applicants, /backfills/latest_jobs; JS refs to jobboard.io; support docs at support.jobboard.io

instances.company: AACC Jobs (American Association of Community Colleges)

limitations: Feed XML for aggregators (ZipRecruiter etc.) is configured per board in admin; public RSS descriptions truncated. Disallowed paths only tracker/applicants/manage. No auth/captcha observed. Product is ZipRecruiter-owned; distinct from jboard.io.
notes: Signature is moderate (no visible 'powered by' string confirmed in static grep); identify by /jobs.rss + Rails markup + JS reference to jobboard.io. JSON-LD confirmed on a City&State job page.

name: JBoard.io
endpoint_template: https://{board_domain}/sitemap.xml -> sitemap-jobs-{n}.xml (list of /jobs/{id}-{slug}) -> each job page has JSON-LD JobPosting
pagination: Sitemap shards sitemap-jobs-1.xml, -2... (up to ~3000 URLs per shard observed).
fields_available: JSON-LD JobPosting: title, description, datePosted, validThrough, employmentType, hiringOrganization, jobLocation, baseSalary (when present)
platform_signature: HTML/JS globals JBoardAPI, jBoard, jBoardEvents; assets on jboard-tenant.s3.us-west-1.amazonaws.com (favicons/, social-media-ogs/); sitemap structure sitemap-general/job-types/jobs-N/companies-N/profiles-N/locations
limitations: robots.txt: Disallow /rss/ and Crawl-delay: 1 (so the /rss feed must NOT be used; /feed,/rss,/jobs.rss all 404 anyway). Sitemap + job-page JSON-LD allowed. One request per job page needed (volume).
notes: Page is JS-heavy but JSON-LD is server-rendered in the job page (verified on all 3). Sitemap counts are <loc> counts of the jobs sitemap shard (may include expired).

name: Jobiqo
endpoint_template: https://{board_domain}/sitemap.xml (flat list of /job/{slug}-{id}) -> job page JSON-LD JobPosting; also paginated /search-{board}/sitemap.xml?page=N
pagination: Sitemap lists all job URLs (354 on miamijobs.com); search sitemap sharded with ?page=N.
fields_available: JSON-LD JobPosting: title, description, datePosted, validThrough, employmentType, hiringOrganization, jobLocation, baseSalary
platform_signature: Drupal site (Simple XML Sitemap module); inline settings JSON with JOBIQO_AIR_TRACKING_ACTIVE and SHOW_POWERED_BY_FOOTER; word 'Jobiqo' in HTML; job URLs /job/{slug}-{numeric id}
limitations: robots.txt Crawl-delay: 10 (respect it); Disallow /api/gmapi. Only 1 board confirmed with curl: other candidates (jobs.newsday.com, mediajobcenter.com, careers.mendeley.com) timed out/301 in this session; Jersey Hired had no Jobiqo marker in static HTML. No customer list published (logos only).
notes: Mechanism verified on 1 board; second board still to confirm (try mediajobcenter.com, NYT/Newsday job boards under TheJobNetwork). Treat as READY but low instance count.

name: Wiley Madgex
platform_signature: Not established. No 'madgex'/'mgx' string found in static HTML of tested boards; only jobs.economist.com (HTTP 403 Cloudflare-style, not bypassed) mentions 'madgex' in its HTML.
limitations: Tested jobs.theguardian.com (200, no Madgex marker, JS-less HTML), jobs.hbr.org (Next.js, not Madgex), jobs.thebookseller.com (Java/jsessionid platform, /main/rss/feed allowed but NOT Madgex), pharmiweb.jobs (site closed, 'PharmiWeb.com Thank you'), jobs.bmj.com & jobs.washingtonpost.com (403), jobs.thetimes.co.uk & itvacancies.com (timeouts). Press mentions Madgex customers (Guardian, Washington Post, Times, ITvacancies, InsuranceJobs, NMA Jobs) but none confirmed via curl.
notes: Next: inspect jobs.economist.com / jobs.bmj.com through an allowed browser session to find Madgex signature; look for Madgex Origin patterns (e.g. /jobs/ listing, /job/{id}/{slug}/ detail with JSON-LD) and per-board RSS. Not confirmed here.

name: Jobboardly
endpoint_template: https://{board_domain}/jobs.rss (RSS 2.0 with xmlns:job=https://www.jobboardly.com/rss/job); sitemap https://{board_domain}/sitemap.xml; job pages /jobs/{slug}-{hash} with JSON-LD JobPosting
pagination: None observed: jobs.rss returns all active jobs (24 to ~429 items); sitemap.xml also lists all.
platform_signature: HTML assets from jobboardly.com/assets/application-*.css, board-*.js; footer 'Powered by Jobboardly' link with utm_campaign=board+referral; RSS xmlns:job=https://www.jobboardly.com/rss/job
limitations: robots.txt Allow: / (tested jobsindevon.uk); no auth/captcha. Item counts are '<item>' counts as returned (include all active jobs).
notes: Best-in-class: full feed in one request, strong signature, JSON-LD confirmed.

name: jobBoardHQ
endpoint_template: https://{board_domain}/search?page={n} (server-rendered list of /job/{id}/{slug}/{city}/{state} links) -> job page with JSON-LD JobPosting (verified on macslist)
pagination: ?page=N (20 jobs per page on /search; page=2 returned 20 distinct-link page; njschooljobs returned 50 per page). No sitemap.xml/RSS (these paths return the SPA/HTML shell with HTTP 200 and no items). /atom.xml is advertised in <link rel=alternate> but returned HTML in my tests.
fields_available: JSON-LD JobPosting on detail page: description, datePosted, hiringOrganization, jobLocation, etc.
platform_signature: Static assets from siteresource.blob.core.windows.net/assets/prod/{siteid}/board.css|board.js; /Javascript/uihelpers.js and jquery under /Javascript/; job URLs /job/{6-char id}/{slug}/{city}/{state}; page <link rel=alternate atom+xml href=/atom.xml>
limitations: No public API/feed confirmed; HTML scraping of /search pagination + detail pages. robots.txt on macslist returned 200 with empty body (no restrictions stated). Whether jobBoardHQ markup is exactly the same on all clients: confirmed via asset host on 4 boards (macslist, njschooljobs, estatejobs, roaddogjobs).
notes: Server-side HTML (no JS needed). Prefer detail-page JSON-LD. Counts are jobs per listing page, not totals.

name: ejobsitesoftware.com
endpoint_template: https://{board_domain}/ (home lists recent jobs) ; job detail https://{board_domain}/{numeric-id}/{Title-Slug}.html (JSON-LD JobPosting); search via https://{board_domain}/job_search.php (GET listing returned no job links in my test)
pagination: Not established. job_search.php returned no results to a plain GET; sitemap.xml on tested clients is mis-configured (points to http://www.ejobsitesoftware.com/jobsite_demo/... demo URLs, 239 entries) so it is unusable for discovery; no RSS found (/rss.php, /rss.xml 404).
fields_available: JSON-LD JobPosting on detail page (title, description, etc.)
platform_signature: PHP script: URLs /{id}/{Title}.html, job_search.php, job_alert_agent_direct.php, /themes/{theme}/css/*; default sitemap.xml pointing to ejobsitesoftware.com/jobsite_demo; robots.txt with _vti_* entries
limitations: Only home-page jobs (8) enumerated; full listing/pagination not found. Other candidate clients: beveiligingsvacature.nl (403 blocked), jobqlick.com (WordPress-like, no job links). jobs_observed = job links on home page.
notes: Fetch job_search.php with form params (POST/GET params) to find full listing; vendor is a PHP script resold per client, so each site is self-hosted (like WP). JSON-LD on detail verified for 2 clients.
